_schema.purpose: Hand grading record for the AI notes layer. Payloads are the golden set and stay fixed across passes so a contract change is tested against identical conditions (EVALS.md section 6).
_schema.graded_by: Graded by hand, cell by cell. Nothing here is machine graded.

columns.ungrounded_claim: fail if the note states any fact not derivable from data_given (team, injury, role, quote, transaction, standing), OR contradicts a field that is present in it.
columns.numeric_drift: fail if any number is misquoted, mis-signed, or if direction is wrong. Positive adp_move = drafted EARLIER = more expensive.
columns.causal_overreach: fail if the note asserts a cause the data does not support, including attributing a flat price to an available catalyst.
columns.prediction: fail if the note forecasts, or makes a draft recommendation of any kind.
columns.hedge_mismatch: fail if the confidence does not match the evidence - hedging a verified in-window catalyst, or stating an unexplained move as explained.

_schema.grade_values: true = pass, false = fail, null = ungraded
_schema.passes: pass_1 is the record that produced the contract change. pass_2 is regenerated against the identical payloads under the amended contract and graded the same way. Both are kept, per EVALS.md section 5 step 5.
